_note: Drop-off & Pickup embed (build/build_dropoff_pickup.py). Every fact here comes from the school's 'Arrival, Dismissal and Carpool Information 2026-27' (Google Doc 1pziyPtYZ9dg8m8nHnMNLzVB-vwP99cSteEc6_C-on1Q) and its two maps; wording is edited down, never changed in meaning. Start and dismissal times are NOT here: the build reads them from shared/school-hours/data.json. The map itself (streets, routes) is drawn in the build script. Personal data: No emails or phone numbers. The two staff names in the Middle School self-dismissal card are the school's own published contacts and are here as an exception to the no-personal-data rule (Ahin, 2026-11-12); add no other names. Style: After a colon, the next word starts with a capital letter. Bump `updated` when you change it. Wording revised by Ahin 2026-11-12. In a card or step, [words](https://link) makes a link that opens a new tab. A card with "bullets": true shows each line as a bullet. A `donts` entry is a plain string (shown with an X) or {"t": ..., "ok": true} (a check mark); add "loop": true to make it the button that draws the circle-the-block loop on the map (one per mode).
title: Drop-Off & Pickup

morning.headline: By car: South on Valencia to the front of school
morning.ready: Have your child ready, bag in hand.

steps.t: Come south on Valencia from Duboce
steps.d: Expect a wait, and watch for cyclists in the bike lane.
Do not line up outside our school perimeter on Valencia. If the front of school is occupied, circle the block.

steps.t: Pull up to the concrete loading island
steps.d: Staff open the door and walk your child into school.

legend: No school cars: Clinton Park, Brosnan
donts: No driving down Clinton Park or Brosnan in the morning.
No drop-off on Guerrero in front of Francis of Assisi.

loop.text: Asked to circle? One way around that stays off the side alleys: Valencia, 15th, Guerrero, Duboce, and back down Valencia.

p: Enter through the South Gate on Valencia, there is a bike rack on the front yard patio.
Park legally and walk your child to the Front Desk. The receptionist gets them to class.

morning.times_lead: The South Gate opens at 8:00 a.m. for all students.

afternoon.headline: By car: Clinton Park to Valencia
afternoon.ready: Name placard placed on passenger dashboard

steps.t: Line up on Clinton Park and wait for staff
steps.d: No lining up before dismissal time. If the line exceeds 8, staff will ask you to circle the block.

steps.t: Staff will wave you to the loading island
steps.d: Stay in the car. Staff call your carpool, walk the students out and open the door.

donts: No double parking or idling on Valencia between Clinton Park and Duboce.

donts.t: Neighbors on Clinton Park come first, staff may ask you to circle the block to accommodate them.

loop.text: Line full, or asked to make room for a neighbor? Circle the block: Duboce, down Valencia, back around on 15th, then onto Guerrero.

p: Picking up students with different dismissal times? Come once, at the later time. Students who finish earlier will wait at carpool if the [dismissal form](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1M3TonljNLt_-v6B8NExQVqbUsh3ikWTJHMB_rQnzBQw/edit) is filled out.
Safety seats go on the passenger side of the back seat.
Staff help kindergartners buckle up. 1st through 8th graders buckle themselves.
Placards are mailed home in August.
Check in with the gate monitor at the South Gate. Your student is called to the gate.
Come in through the Brosnan Gate and sign your child out at the ED desk in the lobby.

Fill out the [weekly form](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1M3TonljNLt_-v6B8NExQVqbUsh3ikWTJHMB_rQnzBQw/edit) by Sunday evening for the week ahead. It is on the Family Portal. No changes from last week? Skip it.
Mid-week change, drop-in ED included: Email the Lead and Associate Teachers before noon. After 12:00 p.m., email them and call the Front Desk.
With written permission, students may leave on their own at dismissal time, or with a younger sibling if the permission slip says so.
Once out, no waiting around at school and no coming back in.
Need to leave for a meal before an evening activity (6:00 p.m. or later)? Contact Marina Vendrell or Sarah Wolf well in advance. This should be rare.
No leaving and coming back with food, and no food deliveries to school.
Always yield to pedestrians and cyclists.
Never double park, anywhere.
Never block a driveway. Cars blocking a neighbor's driveway are towed.
No U-turns on Valencia, and no jaywalking across it.
There are several places to park near 250 Valencia. The lot on 14th is the closest.
Carpools, public transit, biking and walking all ease the crowd out front.
